purpose: Keep vertical-specific Search and agent recommendations out of the universal baseline. A site activates one primary class and may opt into additional modules when they truthfully apply.

recommendedStructuredData: SoftwareApplication or TechArticle where genuinely applicable
documentation.notes: Do not invent Product/Article markup solely for Search appearance.

editorial.notes: FAQ rich results were deprecated by Google in 2026; FAQ markup is not a current Google growth shortcut.

software-product.notes: Agent interfaces and llms.txt are interoperability features, not Google ranking factors.

focus: commerce agent protocols where actually supported
commerce.notes: Commerce/UCP support should be a separate adapter/module, not a universal ARWP requirement.

local-business.notes: Local recommendations require geographic/business context and should not be generalized to non-local sites.

research-dataset.notes: Negative results, sampling limitations and version history are evidence features, not defects to hide.

general.notes: Use a more specific vertical when the site has a clear primary purpose.
